request.style: English, celtic, female solo voice with warm alto tone, solo with distant choir, acoustic guitar, bodhran, flute, cello, harp, reverent and steady mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jeconiah the captive lived in Babylon
His sons were listed in the royal line
Pedaiah stands among the names recorded
Malchiram, Shenazzar, and Hoshama too

[Chorus]
A seat of honor above the other kings
He spoke kindly and the prison clothes were gone
He ate at the king's table for his life
The Davidic promise kept within the line

[Verse]
Zerubbabel was Pedaiah's son
He led the exiles back to Jerusalem
They set the altar on its foundations
To offer burnt offerings to the Lord

[Chorus]
A seat of honor above the other kings
He spoke kindly and the prison clothes were gone
He ate at the king's table for his life
The Davidic promise kept within the line

[Verse]
They began the work of the house of God
With masons and carpenters from Sidon
Cedar logs shipped from Lebanon by sea
The temple rising in the second year

[Chorus]
A seat of honor above the other kings
He spoke kindly and the prison clothes were gone
He ate at the king's table for his life
The Davidic promise kept within the line

[Outro]
From the exile to the temple stone
The lineage holds the promise known
